value.rationale: This completely compares open, one-periodic and two-periodic boundary conditions for the smallest three-by-three Cartesian square grid. The two new exact homotopy types and their contrast with the established open case are natural benchmarks for matching-complex topology. A full finite integral classification is valuable independently of an arbitrary-width extension.
